description_en: Updates a compliance pack in a specified account group
description_zh: 修改指定账号组内的合规包信息
kebab_example: aliyun config update-aggregate-compliance-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --description '基于等保2.0三级标准，提供持续检测合规性的建议模板，帮助您提前自检并修复问题，以便快速通过正式检测。' --risk-level 1 --config-rules '[{"ConfigRuleId":"cr-e918626622af000f0000","Description":"弹性公网已绑定到ECS或者NAT实例，非闲置状态，视为“合规”。","ConfigRuleName":"检测闲置弹性公网IP","ManagedRuleIdentifier":"eip-bandwidth-limit","RiskLevel":1,"ConfigRuleParameters":[{"ParameterValue":"20","ParameterName":"bandwidth"}]}]' --client-token 1594295238-f9361358-5843-4294-8d30-b5183fac0000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --compliance-pack-name '等保三级预检合规包' --region-ids-scope cn-hangzhou --exclude-region-ids-scope cn-shanghai --exclude-resource-ids-scope eip-8vbf3x310fn56ijfd0000 --resource-ids-scope lb-5cmbowstbkss9ta030000 --resource-group-ids-scope rg-aekzc7r7rhx0000 --exclude-resource-group-ids-scope rg-bnczc6r7rml0000 --tag-key-scope ECS --tag-value-scope test --tags-scope TagKey=key-1 TagValue=value-1 --exclude-tags-scope TagKey=key-2 TagValue=value-2 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAggregateCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance pack.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.example: 基于等保2.0三级标准，提供持续检测合规性的建议模板，帮助您提前自检并修复问题，以便快速通过正式检测。
parameters.help_en: The description of the compliance pack
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the compliance pack. Valid values:

1: high risk.

2: medium risk.

3: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
合规包的风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
parameters.name: risk_level

fields.help_en:
The identifier of the rule template. CloudConfig automatically creates a rule based on the rule template identifier and adds the rule to the compliance pack.

You must specify either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If you specify both parameters, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则模板标识。配置审计根据规则模板标识自动创建规则，并将该规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确。关于如何获取托管规则标识，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: managed_rule_identifier

fields.help_en:
The name of the rule parameter.

You must specify `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` together, or leave both empty. If a rule template has a parameter without a default value, you must specify the parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则参数名称。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认取值，则您必须设置该参数。关于如何获取规则模板的参数名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: parameter_name

fields.help_en:
The value of the rule parameter.

You must specify `ParameterName` and `ParameterValue` together, or leave both empty. If a rule template has a parameter without a default value, you must specify the parameter. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.help_zh:
规则参数值。

参数`ParameterName`和`ParameterValue`必须同时设置，或同时不设置。如果规则模板存在参数，且无默认取值，则您必须设置该参数。关于如何获取规则模板的参数值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/261176.html
fields.name: parameter_value

fields.help_en:
The rule ID. CloudConfig adds the existing rule to the compliance pack.

You must specify either `ManagedRuleIdentifier` or `ConfigRuleId`. If you specify both parameters, `ConfigRuleId` takes precedence. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
fields.help_zh:
规则ID。配置审计将已有规则加入到当前合规包中。

`ManagedRuleIdentifier`和`ConfigRuleId`二选一，当两个参数都设置时，以`ConfigRuleId`为准确。关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
fields.name: config_rule_id

fields.example: 弹性公网已绑定到ECS或者NAT实例，非闲置状态，视为“合规”。
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

2: medium risk.

3: low risk
fields.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
fields.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The rules in the compliance pack.

If you leave this parameter empty when you modify the compliance pack, the existing rules are not changed. If you specify new rules, the new rules replace the existing ones
parameters.help_zh:
合规包中的规则列表。

当您修改合规包时，如果规则列表为空，则保持原有规则列表不变；如果规则列表不为空，则使用新规则替换原有规则列表中的规则
parameters.name: config_rules

parameters.help_en: A client token. It is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value that is unique among different requests. The `ClientToken` parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.help_en: The compliance pack is effective only for resources in the specified regions. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rules are not effective for resources in the specified regions. Resources in these regions are not evaluated. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定地域内资源无效，即不对该地域内资源执行评估。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_region_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance pack is not effective for the specified resources. The specified resources are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rules are effective only for the specified resources. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The compliance pack is effective only for resources in the specified resource groups. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_group_ids_scope

parameters.help_en: The rules are not effective for resources in the specified resource groups. Resources in these resource groups are not evaluated. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 规则对指定资源组ID中的资源无效，即不对该资源组内的资源评估。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: exclude_resource_group_ids_scope
